# Real camera files used by the RAW decode tests (src/raw/tests.rs).
# They are downloaded by scripts/fetch-raw-fixtures.sh and are never committed.
# Both the script and the tests read this file; CI caches on its hash.
#
# One fixture per line, fields separated by " | ":
#   id | file | sha256 | bytes | format | camera | width | height | expect | url
#
# width/height are the decoded, EXIF-oriented dimensions (height > width means a
# portrait frame). camera is RawMetadata::camera. expect is "ok" (must decode)
# or "reject" (must fail to decode, e.g. unsupported Canon sRAW). All files are
# CC0 on raw.pixls.us; see testdata/raw/README.md.
